verdict.rationale: DPMA is the German patent and trade mark office. Its offering is public patent/trade-mark databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing routes (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro), not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client consuming other servers' tools. Plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or tool-consumption capability.
